desc: **Task 1 — Reduction & baseline design:** deleting x ≥ 0 never helps; only distinct negative values are candidates; baseline = non-empty Kadane; edge cases (n == 1, all elements identical, all-negative arrays).
**Task 2 — Core implementation:** per-negative-value gap merging + baseline, assembled into `class Solution.maxSubarraySum`.

**Task 3 — Verification:** desk-check/cross-check on all edge cases (`[-1]`, `[-2,-2]`, `[1,-1,1]`, `[0,-1,0]`, `[-3,-3,5,-3]`, multi-occurrence interior-gap cases) and both examples; query-index bounds and empty-gap/empty-result handling proven.

**Task 4 — Performance/polish:** segment tree replaced by O(1)-per-gap sparse-table range max/min on prefix sums (built with C-level `map`), O(n log n) build, ≤ 2·10⁵ O(1) gap queries; worst cases (many distinct negatives, one repeated value) covered; final deliverable is the current solution.
